structure.limits: Deterministic source and structure checks, not a language-model judgment of tone, complete lore, balance, or faithful tabletop mechanics. Digital effects are compared with the labeled prototype configuration, not promoted to printed rules.

semantics.limits: Exact factual/structural checks against pinned sources and approved controlled language. Free-form tone, full lore, balance and faithful tabletop conversion require separate review. Unknown source directions hold rather than silently using stale templates.
